mapper.sql: m.*, u.nickname AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar, (SELECT s.name FROM shops AS s WHERE s.owner_id = m.sender_id AND s.type = CASE WHEN m.category = 'service' THEN 'service' ELSE 'mall' END AND s.archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS sender_shop_name, (SELECT s.logo FROM shops AS s WHERE s.owner_id = m.sender_id AND s.type = CASE WHEN m.category = 'service' THEN 'service' ELSE 'mall' END AND s.archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS sender_shop_logo
mapper.select: SELECT FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, category, type, user_id, target_id, last_message, last_message_id, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM conversations WHERE category = #{category} AND ((user_id = #{userId} AND target_id = #{targetId}) OR (user_id = #{targetId} AND target_id = #{userId})) LIMIT 1

SELECT c.*, cp.unread_count, CASE WHEN c.user_id = #{userId} THEN c.target_id ELSE c.user_id END AS other_user_id, ou.nickname AS other_user_name, ou.avatar AS other_user_avatar, (SELECT s.name FROM shops AS s WHERE s.owner_id = ou.id AND s.type = CASE WHEN c.category = 'service' THEN 'service' ELSE 'mall' END AND s.archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS other_shop_name, (SELECT s.logo FROM shops AS s WHERE s.owner_id = ou.id AND s.type = CASE WHEN c.category = 'service' THEN 'service' ELSE 'mall' END AND s.archived_at IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS other_shop_logo, other_cp.last_read_message_id AS other_last_read_message_id FROM conversations AS c INNER JOIN conversation_participants AS cp ON cp.conversation_id = c.id AND cp.user_id = #{userId} INNER JOIN conversation_participants other_cp ON other_cp.conversation_id = c.id AND other_cp.user_id <> #{userId} LEFT JOIN users AS ou ON ou.id = CASE WHEN c.user_id = #{userId} THEN c.target_id ELSE c.user_id END WHERE c.id = #{conversationId} AND cp.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation_participants (conversation_id, user_id) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM conversation_participants WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_participants cp SET cp.unread_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages AS m WHERE m.conversation_id = cp.conversation_id AND m.receiver_id = cp.user_id AND m.is_read = 0 AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ), cp.last_read_message_id = CASE WHEN #{lastMessageId} IS NULL THEN cp.last_read_message_id WHEN cp.last_read_message_id IS NULL OR cp.last_read_message_id < #{lastMessageId} THEN #{lastMessageId} ELSE cp.last_read_message_id END, cp.last_read_at = NOW() WHERE cp.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND cp.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unread_count), 0) FROM conversation_participants WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.category AS category, COALESCE(SUM(cp.unread_count), 0) AS unread_count FROM conversation_participants AS cp INNER JOIN conversations AS c ON c.id = cp.conversation_id WHERE cp.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.category
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message = #{preview}, last_message_at = #{messageAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{conversationId}
